:::{#def-hamming-distance}
#### Hamming distance and minimum distance

The **Hamming distance** $\hamdist{x}{y}$ between two strings
$x, y \in \codealph^n$ is the number of positions $i$ with $x_i \ne y_i$.
The **minimum distance** of a [block code](#def-block-code) with codewords $C$ is

$$d \eqdef \min \set{\hamdist{c}{c'} : c, c' \in C, \ c \ne c'}.$$

:::
